meta.name: BEST WAREHOUSE EVER
meta.description: Appliance distribution center layout — synthetic reference configuration

origin.description: The point (0, 0, 0) is at the southeast corner of the DOCK_LOADING zone, where the east dock wall meets the south exterior wall. All warehouse coordinates are relative to this fixed building corner.
origin.physical_marker: Floor bolt at southeast dock corner — paint or epoxy a crosshair here during site setup

coordinate_system.x_axis: East is positive. Moving west into the warehouse = negative X.
coordinate_system.y_axis: North is positive. Moving from dock into warehouse interior = positive Y.
coordinate_system.z_axis: Up is positive. Floor slab = 0. Each rack level adds height per bin_type.

bin_label_format.note: Maps to HomeSource WHSELocation field under the parent Location record

node_kinds.access_point: Entry/exit opening — doors, ramps, bay openings to exterior or between zones
node_kinds.waypoint: Navigable aisle intersection used for routing — no physical feature, just a graph node
node_kinds.staging_area: Temporary hold zone where units queue before put-away or before truck loading
node_kinds.reference_marker: Survey reference point — not navigable, used only to anchor the coordinate system to a physical location

rack_orientation_key.length_along_y: Rack bays extend in the +Y (north) direction from the rack origin
rack_orientation_key.length_along_x: Rack bays extend in the +X (east) direction from the rack origin

bin_status.note: Bin status is LIVE STATE stored in the database, not in this config file. The config defines physical structure; the database tracks what is in each bin at runtime.

valid_values.occupied: Bin contains a unit — whse_location maps to a unit record
valid_values.reserved: Bin is claimed by an in-progress put-away task but unit not yet placed
valid_values.damaged: Bin or rack section is physically damaged — do not assign
valid_values.blocked: Bin is temporarily inaccessible (e.g. obstruction, maintenance)

PALLET_RACK_STD.description: Standard pallet rack slot — fits most mid-size appliances (washers, dryers, dishwashers)
PALLET_RACK_STD.dimensions_note: w=width(m), d=depth(m), h=height(m) of usable bin opening

PALLET_RACK_TALL.description: Tall pallet rack slot — fits upright appliances (refrigerators, freezers, water heaters)
PALLET_RACK_TALL.dimensions_note: w=width(m), d=depth(m), h=height(m) of usable bin opening

FLOOR_DISPLAY.description: Floor-level display area — customer-facing showroom units, no racking
FLOOR_DISPLAY.dimensions_note: w=width(m), d=depth(m), h=height(m) of usable bin opening

SMALL_PARTS_RACK.description: Small parts rack — accessories, hardware, replacement parts
SMALL_PARTS_RACK.dimensions_note: w=width(m), d=depth(m), h=height(m) of usable bin opening

FORKLIFT_STANDARD.description: Standard counterbalance forklift — general put-away and retrieval

REACH_TRUCK.description: Narrow-aisle reach truck — high-level picks in tight aisles

PALLET_JACK.description: Manual or electric pallet jack — floor-level moves, staging, dock work

dwell_times.description: Estimated time in seconds for a forklift to place or retrieve a unit at each rack level. Includes approach, raise/lower forks, align, and clear.

operations.safety_note: Active truck bay zone — spotter required when trucks are docked. Pedestrians must use designated walkway.
Overflow and bulk storage — forklift traffic only

operations.forklift_permitted_hours: Outside store hours only, with floor manager approval
operations.safety_note: Customer-facing — no forklifts during store hours. Use pallet jack for restocking.
Hard hat and high-vis vest required at all times
